title: Components factory: two twelve-hour shifts
question: What could happen if a components factory moves from three eight-hour shifts to two twelve-hour shifts?

documents.name: 01-plant-proposal.md
documents.content:
# Plant proposal: two twelve-hour shifts

This is a fictional proposal written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Proposal

Corvane Components, a factory with 310 employees, proposes to replace three eight-hour shifts with two twelve-hour shifts, from 6am to 6pm and 6pm to 6am. The plant manager expects fewer handovers between shifts and one fewer changeover of the machines each day.

## Reasons

Absence on the night shift is the highest in the plant. The operations director wants to reduce overtime, which cost the plant about £420,000 last year.

## Timing

The plant manager would like to start in the new financial year.

documents.name: 02-health-safety-and-law.md
documents.content:
# Health and safety review

This is a fictional review written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Working time

The working time rules say that workers must have 11 hours of rest between shifts and must not average more than 48 hours a week. Twelve-hour shifts on a four-day rota average 42 hours, but a block of seven twelve-hour nights would breach the rest rule unless a day off is added.

## Fatigue

The occupational health adviser requires a fatigue risk assessment to be completed and signed before any change to shift length. The assessment takes about six weeks. The adviser warns that the risk of errors rises after the tenth hour of work, especially on nights.

## Machines

Three of the presses cannot be left running unattended, and the foundry furnace must be tended at every hour.

documents.name: 03-union-and-workforce-note.md
documents.content:
# Union and workforce note

This is a fictional note written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Agreement

The collective agreement requires 60 days' notice of any change to shift patterns and a vote of the workforce, which must be carried by a majority of members.

## Views

The union representatives say many workers like longer breaks between blocks of shifts but worry about nights, caring duties and the journey home at 6am. About 40 agency workers fill gaps on nights and are not covered by the agreement. Canteen hours are set by the catering contractor, who serves meals only until 9pm and from 5am.

## Transport and overtime

The works bus runs three times a day at shift changes and would need a new timetable. The union says overtime cost the plant about £310,000 last year.
